title: Median Household Income by Zip Code in Hennepin County
text: This map shows median household income for each zip code in Hennepin County, Minnesota. Each zip code is colored by its median household income. Light lavender means lower income and dark purple means higher income. Grey zip codes have no income data, mostly because they are PO Box zip codes where nobody lives.

title: Median Household Income by Zip Code in Hennepin County
text: This map shows median household income for each zip code in Hennepin County, Minnesota. Each zip code is colored by its median household income. Light lavender means lower income and dark purple means higher income. Grey zip codes have no income data, mostly because they are PO Box zip codes where nobody lives.

title: Median Household Income by Zip Code in Hennepin County
text:
Why I made it
I wanted to see how income differs across the county, since income is one of the factors that could help explain patterns in my group’s Hennepin County case data. My case data is recorded by zip code, so a zip code map lets me put the two side by side later.

title: Median Household Income by Zip Code in Hennepin County
text:
How to read it

Compare colors, not exact numbers. The legend shows the range, and darker means higher.
A zip code is an area, not a person. A median income describes the middle household in that zip, so individual households can be much higher or lower.
Grey does not mean zero. It means the data is missing.

title: Median Household Income by Zip Code in Hennepin County
text:
What I noticed
The darkest zip codes are in the western and northwestern parts of the county, also one narrow zipcode in the south that stands out as the highest of all of them. The lightest zip codes are near along the eastern side of the county, where the zipcodes are small and closer together, which maybe suggests lower median incomes there.

title: Median Household Income by Zip Code in Hennepin County
text:
Where the data comes from
The zip code shapes come from the Hennepin County shapefile my professor provided. The income numbers come from the zipcodeR package in R.

title: Exploring Hennepin County Zip Codes: An Interactive Map
